Question 3
?

Given that L{tn}=n!sn+1 for s>0, find L{u(t−6)(t2−t+3)}, where u(t) is the unit step function.

a
e−s(2s3+11s2+33s)
b
e6s(2s3−11s2)
c
e−6s(2s3+11s2)
d
e−6s(2s3+11s2+33s)
e
e−6s(1s3+−1s2+3s)
